perf.summary: Replace PopCount bit-loop with BitOperations.PopCount and iterate IsIndependentSet over set bits only (same fixes as Chromatic).
perf.currentCost: Per mask in [0,2^n): IsIndependentSet does n^2 bit tests with recomputed shifts and long index math; PopCount loops bit-by-bit. Hot loop runs 2^n times.
perf.proposedChange: Use (int)System.Numerics.BitOperations.PopCount((uint)mask); rewrite IsIndependentSet to walk set bits via TrailingZeroCount and use int i*n+j indexing (n<=30 so product < 2^31).
perf.rationale: popcnt intrinsic replaces a data-dependent loop; set-bit iteration reduces inner work from n^2 to popcount^2; 32-bit indexing shortens the address-compute chain. All in the 2^n-iteration hot path.
perf.risk: uint cast for popcount is safe (mask>=0). int index safe for all valid n (n<=30 -> n*n<=900M<2^31). No observable change.
